params.censoredRule: value = tries so far + 1 (lower bound of tries to first win); cap 20
params.boardRule: real_ledger.js (app version >= release of present board, tile count and clock moves match); levels 70-84 additionally need app >= 1.52 (75-105 are 1.52 boards); levels < 70 not in the hard table and not read; a player who won on an older board is dropped from that level

playerEffect.model: log(tries) = level + player on levels with >=2 normal players; factors relative, geometric mean 1
